stories.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.
stories.zh_title: AI代理新創公司LangChain估值達30億美元
stories.zh_summary: LangChain 目前聲稱其模型和平台無關的代理管理工具 LangSmith 擁有 7,000 名客戶。

stories.title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
stories.summary: Normally, the products I test don't offer to help me write up my experience with them. Duet is different. Claude Duet is Anthropic's AI agent for consumers, the latest attempt by an AI company to try to convince us that agents can be useful for people who don't write code. It's been an interesting couple […]
stories.zh_title: 克勞德的二重奏經紀人有點神經質，但出奇的樂於助人
stories.zh_summary: 通常，我測試的產品不會幫助我寫下我的使用體驗。二重奏是不同的。 Claude Duet 是 Anthropic 面向消費者的人工智慧代理，這是一家人工智慧公司的最新嘗試，試圖讓我們相信代理對於不編寫程式碼的人來說也是有用的。這是一個有趣的c

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
stories.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
stories.zh_title: 創投家和創辦人表示，黃仁勳的離職導致人工智慧新創公司資金出現巨大缺口
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達向黃仁勳領導下的人工智慧新創公司投入了數百億美元。沒有他的掌舵，創辦人和創投公司將面臨較小的支票和較低的估值。

stories.title: AMD and other chip stocks slide as Wall Street rethinks the AI trade without Jensen Huang
stories.summary: At first, it looked like Nvidia’s pain might be the rest of the chip sector’s gain. But now, investors aren’t so sure.
stories.zh_title: 隨著華爾街重新考慮黃仁勳缺席的人工智慧交易，AMD 和其他晶片股下滑
stories.zh_summary: 起初，看起來英偉達的痛苦可能是晶片產業其他部分的收益。但现在，投资者不太确定。

stories.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
stories.summary: After launching its Dots AI agents platform earlier this year, OpenAI is launching a wallet for the agents. ChatGPT Wallet is rolling out starting today for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US aged 18 and older using a US billing address and "eligible US-issued American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa cards." After adding a card […]
stories.zh_title: ChatGPT 錢包可讓 OpenAI 的 Dots 代理為您購買
stories.zh_summary: 繼今年稍早推出 Dots AI 代理平台後，OpenAI 又推出了一款針對代理商的錢包。 ChatGPT 錢包從今天開始向美國 18 歲及以上的 ChatGPT Pro 用戶推出，使用美國賬單地址和“符合條件的美國發行的美國運通卡、大通卡、萬事達卡和

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users
stories.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet partners with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, and those cardholders keep their existing credit card rewards.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 錢包，允許其「點」人工​​智慧代理為用戶進行購買
stories.zh_summary: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 錢包與美國運通卡、萬事達卡和 Visa 合作，這些持卡人保留其現有的信用卡獎勵。

stories.title: Nvidia’s stock is on a losing streak not seen in 14 years. What comes next?
stories.summary: Nvidia wiped out $573 billion in market capitalization this week — its sixth consecutive week of stock declines.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達的股價正經歷 14 年來未見的連續下跌。接下來會發生什麼事？
stories.zh_summary: Nvidia 本週市值蒸發了 5,730 億美元，這是其股價連續第六週下跌。

stories.title: Bitcoin is now below $69,000 and could fall even further if investors cash out to buy into the Anthropic IPO
stories.summary: Investors may have to sell some of their existing bets in crypto to make room in their portfolio for what could be one of the most sought-after stock offerings in history.
stories.zh_title: 比特幣目前低於 69,000 美元，如果投資者套現購買 Anthropic IPO，比特幣可能會進一步下跌
stories.zh_summary: 投資者可能必須出售一些現有的加密貨幣押注，以便在其投資組合中為歷史上最受歡迎的股票發行之一騰出空間。

stories.title: What's ahead for AI financing after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang departs
stories.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation puts Nvidia’s AI financing strategy in focus as investors watch credit markets and neocloud exposure.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達執行長黃仁勳離職後，人工智慧融資前景如何
stories.zh_summary: 隨著投資者關注信貸市場和 Neocloud 風險，黃仁勳的辭職使 Nvidia 的人工智慧融資策略成為焦點。

stories.title: Microsoft 365 Crawls Back to Life After a 24-Hour Outage
stories.summary: The company says a bad update—not a cyberattack or AI—caused its servers around the world to crash.
stories.zh_title: Microsoft 365 在 24 小時中斷後恢復正常
stories.zh_summary: 該公司表示，一次糟糕的更新（而不是網路攻擊或人工智慧）導致其世界各地的伺服器崩潰。

stories.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says central bank 'has definitely got work to do' on inflation
stories.summary: The policymaker expressed concern about the latest inflation data, telling CNBC that the central bank likely will need to take action.
stories.zh_title: 芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行行長古爾斯比表示，央行在通膨問題上“肯定有工作要做”
stories.zh_summary: 這位政策制定者對最新的通膨數據表示擔憂，並告訴 CNBC，央行可能需要採取行動。

stories.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
stories.summary: Given Nvidia’s stronghold on AI and its importance in Israel, many in the country's startup ecosystem are worried about the impact of his departure.
stories.zh_title: 以色列創投公司在英偉達的動盪中看到了挑戰者的機會
stories.zh_summary: 鑑於英偉達在人工智慧領域的地位及其在以色列的重要性，該國新創生態系統中的許多人都擔心他離開的影響。

stories.title: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood
stories.summary: Mansa says its AI microdramas can serve as proofs of concept for what Black audiences want. Critics say the studio is selling out.
stories.zh_title: 這家新創公司押注人工智慧微劇，以在好萊塢獲得更多黑人故事
stories.zh_summary: 曼薩表示，其人工智慧微劇可以作為黑人觀眾想要的概念證明。批評者稱該工作室已售罄。

stories.title: Nvidia closes below $4T market cap for first time since July 2025 in Huang fallout
stories.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on Thursday after coming under scrutiny for two extramarital affairs.
stories.zh_title: 由於黃仁勳事件的影響，Nvidia 自 2025 年 7 月以來首次收盤低於 4T 美元市值
stories.zh_summary: 黃仁勳因兩次婚外情受到審查後於週四辭去了英偉達首席執行官的職務。

stories.title: The trillion-dollar mistake corporate America is making about retirement
stories.summary: The market is dramatically underpricing the economic impact of Americans age 50 and older.
stories.zh_title: 美國企業界在退休問題上犯下的價值數萬億美元的錯誤
stories.zh_summary: 市場大大低估了 50 歲及以上美國人的經濟影響。

stories.title: A trading strategy to ride out the Nvidia uncertainty and generate income in the process
stories.summary: By deploying a persistent covered call strategy, investors can leverage the exact fear driving the stock down to generate robust, risk-reducing income.
stories.zh_title: 一種能夠度過輝達 (Nvidia) 不確定性，並在此過程中創造收入的交易策略
stories.zh_summary: 透過部署持續的備兌買權策略，投資者可以利用推動股價下跌的恐懼情緒來產生強勁的、降低風險的收入。
